text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Aww yeah! Landed a big one!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship finishes up another fantastic
race!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
This is how an Umamusume of the sea
lives! Now,
to wave my fishing banner
and let everyone know
of my big haul!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Superb. As expected, Golshi.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Well, if it isn't Flash!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You've got a good angler's spirit
yourself! You
practically heaped your
own fishing boat to
capsizing!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
You honor me with your praise. By the
way, do
you remember our agreement?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Sure do. You said you'd trade me your
shark fins
if I landed the legendary giant
squid, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
There seems to be a discrepancy in your
memory
of the details... But, as
promised, this is now
yours.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Gasp! Why, this is...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
A hint to Eden's location, as entrusted to
me by a
certain individual.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
So all I have to do to find Eden is do
what this
says?!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Apologies, but I cannot say. I am but the

messenger.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
However, if you follow the directions
closely, we
shall surely meet again.
Goodbye.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Heh... Now, that's interesting!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You're curious too, huh? All right, I'll
read it to
you!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: "In truth, Eden lies beneath the waves..."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Seeking it blindly would be a nigh
impossible
task. Thus, a puzzle in four
parts has been
prepared to aid you."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Collect the clues by facing even more
formidable
foes! Yours truly, the Book of
Secrets."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Challenge strong opponents to get hints and solve a puzzle, huh? Nice, now I can use my brains and brawns!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Considering what Flash said earlier, I
have a
feeling I'll be racing her again
soon.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oh, this is fun! Let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I still just can't get over that offhand
"Yours truly,
the Book of Secrets" thing
at the end.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Besides, who gave Eishin Flash that
information in
the first place?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I should be more concerned about this
whole
thing, but as long as Gold Ship is
motivated to
race, I find myself willing
to let a lot slide!
